0022600146.text: Both teams enter unbeaten: the Trail Blazers, 3-0 and first in the Northwest, host the Memphis Grizzlies, who are 4-0 and second in the Southwest. Portland will be without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), both listed as out, while Robert Williams III is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and Portland won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 122-114 win in Memphis on March 4, 2026.
